★★★★★ 10,000+ five-star reviews on the Tmrw and Simply Nootropics products I write for.

Greetings! My name is Nicole, but Nicky works just fine! I’m here to help anyone with anything writing-related. And whether you pronounce it Klah-vee-oh or Klay-vee-oh, I promise your emails will sound a lot better once I’ve had a go at them.

You’ve got a business, project, or idea, but the words you need escape you? Well, I can’t relate to that. What I can do is capture those elusive words and shape them into compelling copy that brings your vision to life.

These days I’m Senior Content Strategist for Tmrw and Simply Nootropics, two longevity brands selling across Australia, New Zealand, the UK, Europe and the US. I own their content from start to finish: Klaviyo emails, the SEO blog, the website copy, social and PR. I’ve even built my own suite of AI tools to handle the research and admin, so more of my time goes into the writing itself.

As the self-crowned Empress of Eloquence, I’ve written email strategy and copy for everything from supplements to cryptocurrencies, pre-loved diamonds to flavoured bottles. I’ve written essays about sexuality in Russian literature and created multi-lingual cyphers for fantasy brands. Scroll to my clients’ reviews and you’ll see why I’m the best in the business.

How I WORK

  1. Listen

    I learn your brand, your customers and the claims you can and can’t make, before I write a word.

  2. Plan

    I look at what you already have (flows, rankings, product pages) and find where the easy wins are hiding.

  3. Write

    Every word written by me, in your voice, checked for accuracy and compliance. AI helps with research, never the finished copy.

  4. Refine

    I watch the opens, clicks, rankings and sales, then keep improving what’s working.

COPYWRITING services

Writing is how you communicate with your customers, clients, and readers, so it’s absolutely central to my work. Maybe you dislike writing, suffer from blank page anxiety, or simply don’t have the time or creativity to get it done. Don’t worry, I have enough words for the both of us. With your vision and my expertise, we can give life to your idea together.

Let’s chat

Email Strategy

Say sayonara to boring emails. I’ll help you map the customer journey, build out Klaviyo flows that convert, and write campaigns that actually get clicked, so your audience stays engaged from welcome to win-back. 80M+ emails sent and counting.

Website & Product Copy

I wrote the whole website for both Tmrw and Simply Nootropics: homepages, product pages, FAQs, the lot. Copy that makes a complicated product feel simple, stays compliant and gets people to the checkout.

SEO Blog Writing

Get found on Google and educate your readers. Whatever you need to communicate, I’ll make sure it’s SEO-optimised and hits your target audience, driving conversions. 600+ blogs in, including a #1 spot on Google UK.

PR & Press

Press releases, branded features and the pitch emails that get them placed. My PR for Tmrw has run in the New York Post, USA Today, the Daily Mail, Us Weekly and Uncrate.

Recipe Writing

From all 50 recipes in Kitchen Impossible (the world’s hardest dishes, from 25+ countries) to dozens of published wellness recipes. Clear, precise and actually cookable.

Ghostwriting

Your memoir, travel guides, wedding speeches, funeral elegies, love letters, your grocery list; I enjoy writing them all, and they will all make you cry (yes, the grocery list too).

Language Creation

Jashir rai moyy da. Ya know what I mean? If not, don’t worry. As an experienced linguist, I can create a unique language for your world-building needs and even make people want to learn it. Drawing from my experience with Italian, Russian, French, Ancient Greek, and Latin (just to name a few).

Article Writing

Intermediality as an epistemological tool in contemporary art forms, the influence of Old Church Slavonic on modern Eastern European languages, lesbian vampires: what do all these things have in common? Me.

Questions, answered

Do you write everything yourself?

Yes. Pezza Media is my own freelance practice, so you work with me directly on every word. I use AI for research and outlining, never for the finished writing.

Which platforms do you work in?

I’m in Klaviyo every day, building flows and campaigns, and I write for Shopify stores and blogs. If your platform is different, I’ll learn it quickly.

Can you write for supplements and other regulated products?

That’s my day job. In supplements, one wrong dose or claim is a real problem, so I check everything and keep copy compliant across markets.

Where are you based?

I’m London-based and travelling, and I already work with brands across Australia, New Zealand, the UK, Europe and the US, so time zones aren’t a problem.

How do we get started?

Send me a note through the form below. I’ll come back with a few questions, and we can jump on a call or start with a short paid sample so you can see the fit.

Let’s make your words work harder

Tell me about your brand and what you need. No obligation, no hard sell, and I reply to every enquiry myself.
